title: Gluing fibre-sum area identities over a countable cover
lean_statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) (f : X → Y) (g h : X → ℝ≥0∞) (M : Set X) (G : ℕ → Set X), NullMeasurableSet M μ → (∀ α, NullMeasurableSet (G α) μ) → μ (M \ ⋃ α, G α) = 0 → ν (f '' (M \ ⋃ α, G α)) = 0 → (∀ α, ∀ S ⊆ M ∩ G α, NullMeasurableSet S μ → (∫⁻ x in S, g x ∂μ = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : ↥(S ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}), h x ∂ν) ∧ AEMeasurable (fun y ↦ ∑' x : ↥(S ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}), h x) ν) → ∫⁻ x in M, g x ∂μ = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : ↥(M ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}), h x ∂ν
